profile.headline: Software Engineer at Workday
profile.summary: Full stack software engineer with exposure to all aspects of the software development cycle. Several years of experience in designing and implementing software within micro service based architecture. Hands on experience in with many technologies such as Java, Spring, Quarkus, AWS, Kafka, SQL, and NoSQL databases. Expertise in backend development such as creating REST APIs, collaborating across teams, mentoring, and trying new things.
